author: deepseek-3.2
brief: Phase: refactor. Role: frontend developer. Repo: a plain JavaScript notes app front end whose state lives in one large `src/store.js` (about 400 lines): notes, tags, a sync queue, user settings and toast notifications, with module-level variables, subscribers called in a fixed order, callbacks that call each other, and a few quirks callers depend on (a subscriber that unsubscribes during a notification, default settings merged shallowly, a toast id counter that is module state, ordering of the sync queue). Many files import `store` from it. The request: split it into separate modules per concern (the request names the new paths and exports: pure reducer-style functions per concern and selector functions), keep `src/store.js` as the one public entry with the same exports and behaviour, and keep all existing tests passing. Hidden tests: characterization tests through the old entry points, and structure tests on the new modules (they work alone and the old entry uses them, checked with an injected fake).
